subType: Suspected Bid Rigging and Collusive Tendering
contractDescription: Supply and installation of road safety equipment, guardrails, reflective signage, and traffic management systems for Km 150–320 (Kapiri Mposhi–Ndola segment)
description: During the annual fiduciary review mission (February–March 2025), AfDB procurement specialists identified anomalies in the competitive bidding process for road safety equipment contract RDA/LNDC2/ICB/2021/015 valued at USD 12.5 million. Indicators of suspected bid rigging include: (1) three bidders submitted nearly identical unit prices with minor percentage variations suggesting pre-bid coordination; (2) the winning bidder (Zamroad Safety Systems Ltd) is registered at the same address as the second-lowest bidder (Pan-African Road Solutions Ltd) per Zambia Patents and Companies Registration Agency (PACRA) records; (3) the contract was awarded within 48 hours of bid opening, below the required 7-day evaluation period; (4) an anonymous complaint submitted to AfDB's Independent Recourse Mechanism (IRM) on 15 February 2025 alleged that a senior RDA procurement officer received facilitation payments. The investigation is being conducted jointly by AfDB's Integrity and Anti-Corruption Department (PIAC) and the Zambia Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC).
indicators: Near-identical unit prices from three bidders suggesting pre-bid coordination
Common registered address between winning bidder and second-lowest bidder
Contract awarded within 48 hours, below required 7-day evaluation period
Anonymous complaint to AfDB IRM alleging facilitation payments to RDA procurement officer
investigatingUnit: AfDB Integrity and Anti-Corruption Department (PIAC) — Joint with Zambia Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC)
legalFramework: AfDB Integrity and Anti-Corruption Policy (2012); Zambia Public Procurement Act No. 12 of 2008 (as amended 2020)
immediateActions: Suspension of disbursement for this contract package pending investigation outcome
Notification to RDA Director General and Ministry of Infrastructure Permanent Secretary
Preservation of all bid documents, evaluation records, and correspondence
Engagement of independent forensic accountants (KPMG Zambia) to audit contract expenditures
Escalation to AfDB Country Manager Dr. Damoni Chitala and AfDB Zambia task team
potentialSanctions: Potential debarment of implicated entities from AfDB-financed projects for up to 7 years if bid rigging confirmed. Possible referral for criminal prosecution under Zambian law.
projectImpact: Road safety component delays of approximately 8–12 months anticipated. Overall project completion date may be extended. Remaining USD 4.2M suspended pending investigation; rebidding possible if contract is voided.
notes: This alert does not affect disbursements under other contract packages within the Lusaka-Ndola project. AfDB's IFC co-financing for this project is not involved. The sovereign loan itself remains performing; only the specific contract disbursement is frozen.
